Lesson 6 of 6

Recover from a regional outage

Trail Notes now has cached guide pages and queued photo previews. A region fails at 12:00. A standby can serve guide reads at 12:08, but its latest recoverable committed guide update is at 11:59:20. The team set a 10-minute recovery time objective (RTO) for public reads and a 30-second recovery point objective (RPO) for guide updates. RTO limits how long a function can be down. RPO limits how far back recovered data may fall.

Predict. Which target did the incident meet? What would you verify before reopening writes and restarting preview workers?

Reveal the answer

Public reads recovered in 8 minutes, within their target. The recovery point is 40 seconds before the outage, so the guide-update RPO was missed by 10 seconds. Compare recovered guide versions with acknowledgments or durable records to identify missing updates. Before resuming writes, establish which region owns them. Ensure restarted preview workers process the intended job versions and can safely retry work completed before the outage.

Revisit the original request path and redraw it with the cache, queue, and standby. Label which components serve public reads and which protect author updates.
